title: GSPO: A Graph Substitution and Parallelization Joint Optimization Framework for DNN Inference
problem: Optimizing DNN inference requires finding the best combination of graph substitution and parallelization strategies. Existing frameworks apply these techniques independently, missing potential synergies between joint optimization at the operator level.
motivation: Jointly optimizing graph substitution and parallelization can achieve significantly better DNN inference performance than applying them separately.
method: GSPO introduces a Joint Optimization Computation Graph (JOCG) to represent both graph substitution and parallelization at the operator level. A customized cost model evaluates computation graph execution time efficiently. The framework uses graph partition and backtracking search algorithms to find the optimal joint optimization solution within acceptable search time.
key_novelty: Joint optimization of graph substitution and parallelization using a unified JOCG representation and specialized cost model, rather than applying these techniques independently.
contributions: Unified framework for joint optimization of graph substitution and parallelization
Joint Optimization Computation Graph (JOCG) representation for operator-level optimization
Customized cost model for quick evaluation of joint optimization solutions
Graph partition and backtracking search algorithm achieving optimal solutions efficiently
